transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I almost didn’t make the appointment because it feels a little embarrassing, and I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. But I’ve been having these thoughts sometimes like, if I didn’t wake up tomorrow, maybe that would be easier. I don’t want to hurt myself, really, I don’t. It just scared me enough that I thought I should probably talk to someone… if that makes sense.
How long have you been feeling this way or having these thoughts?

I think… about two months now. Not constantly, exactly, but this whole up-and-down thing with my mood and energy started around when the problems with the new district manager really began. I guess that’s when I first noticed it getting harder.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest or not getting pleasure from things you usually enjoy, like hobbies, work, or time with friends and family?

A little, yes. I mean, I still try to do the things I usually like… like I’ll set out my paints, or I’ll think, “I should go to pottery class, that’ll help.” But then when I’m there, I sort of just sit and stare at the materials. It doesn’t feel bad exactly, just… flat. Like the spark I used to get from it isn’t really there. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy level or found yourself feeling more tired than usual, even when you're doing regular activities?

Yes… I think so. I mean, I’m not collapsing or anything, but even if I’ve been in bed all night, I’ll still feel worn out pretty quickly. Like opening the store, answering just a few staff questions, or even carrying groceries in from the car can feel like more than it should. Maybe that sounds minor, but it’s more than I’m used to.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating much less or much more than usual?

I don’t think so, not in any big way. My appetite’s been… pretty normal, I guess. Maybe some days I don’t think much about food until later, but I haven’t noticed my clothes fitting differently or anything like that. Is that what you mean?
Have you found yourself feeling more guilty or like you're not good enough for things lately?

Maybe a little… I don’t want to make it sound dramatic. But I do catch myself going over small things at work, like if a display sign was crooked or one of the trainees looked confused after I explained something. And then I’ll think, “Well, what kind of supervisor am I if I can’t even get that right?” It’s probably silly, but in the moment I can start feeling pretty useless.
Have you noticed yourself thinking more slowly than usual or moving more slowly, like your thoughts or body feel sluggish or weighed down?

A little, yes… though I don’t know if I’d call it severe or anything. Some days I notice I’m kind of pacing around the living room and picking at my cuticles, like I can’t quite settle. And then other days it’s the opposite—just walking from the break room to the sales floor feels oddly slow, like my body is heavier than it should be. Does that make sense?
Have you ever felt this way before, with your mood and energy being so low for a period of time?

Yes… I think so. I mean, not exactly like I’m falling apart or anything, but this low, kind of flat feeling has been around for… probably about six months now. Long enough that the things that usually help me reset, like my art class or my morning walks, just haven’t really been doing that anymore. I kept thinking it would pass, but it’s been lingering.
Have you ever had a period of time before this one where you felt this low or down for more than two weeks and it interfered with your usual life or activities?

I’m not sure, honestly. I mean, I’ve had rough patches before, like anyone, but I don’t know that I’d say it was clearly more than two weeks or that it really interfered in a major way. I may be forgetting something, but nothing is coming to mind the way this stretch has. Does that answer it okay?
Have you had more than one time in your life before this current period where you felt down or low for several weeks or more?

I don’t think so… not more than one time, at least not that I can clearly point to. I’ve had normal ups and downs, but I can’t honestly remember another stretch of several weeks where I felt low like this. I hope that’s specific enough.

Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period—lasting days or longer—where you felt so down or low that it affected your usual activities, even if it didn’t last as long as this time?

I’m trying to think… before this current stretch, I don’t know that I can point to a clear separate time like that. What I can say is lately, most mornings I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling, like the color is already drained out before I even get dressed for the store.

I don’t want to overstate it, but that’s been the feeling that’s really stood out. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you ever had at least two separate times in your life before this current period where you felt down or low for weeks at a time?

No, I don’t think so. I really can’t identify two separate times like that before this. I’ve had bad weeks here and there, I suppose, but not weeks at a time in a way I’d confidently call separate episodes. Is that okay to say?

Can you think back and confirm if there was ever another time before this current period—lasting at least two weeks—where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had low energy that clearly affected your usual functioning, even if it didn’t last as long as this time?

I’m sorry, I know you’re trying to pin it down clearly. Thinking back, I really don’t remember another separate period before this one that lasted at least two weeks and affected how I functioned in that way.

I may have had ordinary rough patches, like anyone, but nothing I can honestly say was a clear episode like you’re describing. Does that answer it okay?

Can you think back and confirm if there was ever another time before this current period—lasting at least two weeks—where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had low energy that clearly affected your usual functioning, even if it didn’t last as long as this time?

I think the honest answer is still no, not that I can clearly remember. I don’t want to be unhelpful, but I’d rather not make something fit if it didn’t really happen that way.

There may have been times I was tired or discouraged, but not a separate two-week stretch before this where it really changed my functioning. Does that make sense?

Can you think back and confirm if there was ever another time before this current period—lasting at least two weeks—where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had low energy that clearly affected your usual functioning, even if it didn’t last as long as this time?

I’ve really been trying to think of one, and I don’t want to give you the wrong answer just to be agreeable. I honestly can’t point to another time before this that lasted two weeks or more and clearly affected my day-to-day functioning.

I’ve had normal ups and downs, sure, but nothing that stands out to me that way. Is that specific enough?

Can you think back and confirm if there was ever another time before this current period—lasting at least two weeks—where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had low energy that clearly affected your usual functioning, even if it didn’t last as long as this time?

I’m sorry, I feel like I’m not giving you much to work with. I’ve thought about it, and I just don’t have a clear example of another separate time like that before this.

There were probably stressful stretches, but I can’t honestly say there was a two-week period where being down or low-energy really changed how I was functioning. Is that okay to say if I’m not sure?

Can you confirm once again if there has ever been another time in your life—before this current period—where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had low energy for at least two weeks and it clearly affected your usual functioning, even if it didn’t last as long as this time?

Yes… I think I can confirm that. I really don’t remember another separate period before this where it went on for at least two weeks and clearly affected how I was functioning.

I don’t want to overlook something, but nothing comes to mind beyond ordinary hard or tiring times. So my answer would be no, not that I’m aware of.

I think… I’ve answered this the best I can. I don’t remember another time before this current one where it lasted at least two weeks and really affected how I was functioning.

I mean, I’ve had rough periods like anyone, but nothing that clearly fits what you’re describing. I hope that’s okay—I’m not trying to be vague, I just don’t want to say yes if I can’t actually recall it.
